notes.title: Agents of SomeCompany is realeased!
notes.notes:
Hello speedrunners!

[i]Agents of SomeCompany[/i] is released and you can play it for free as it was stated before.

[h2]Content[/h2]

It contains 30 levels divided into 6 chapters where you learn how to use your skills and how to run as fast as possible.

BUT If you want a real challenge after finishing a game you unlock special Speedrun mode where you need to beat the whole game in one sitting and compete for Bronze, Silver, Gold and pretty hard to obtain Diamond medal.

[h2]Assist Mode[/h2]

The first time you run the game you will be asked if you want to turn on Assist Mode. This allows you to change the difficulty of the game and adapt the game for your needs.

You can also change assist settings during the game, but some of the settings will require a restart to fully work.

Note, that enabling this will disable leaderboards.

[h2]Cost[/h2]

As said before the game is free :)

Enjoy & have fun!

notes.title: Agents of SomeCompany will be released on May 30th!
notes.notes:
Hello speedrunners!

Let's get to the point straight away.

[h2]Date[/h2]

[i][b]Agents of SomeCompany[/b][/i] will be be released on May 30th 5PM GMT. So make some time next week to play it!

[h2]Price[/h2]

The price is set to $0.00 and the demo will no longer be active on the page. Because of other commitments I won't be able to update the game for as long as I wanted to, but the game will have all planned content for the premiere.


Hope you like these news and you're even more eager to play it soon :D

See you in a week!

notes.title: Demo version is available again and includes many improvements!
notes.notes:
Hello again!

First and foremost I want to apologize for not releasing it in 2023 as i promised. I'm a couple of days late, but hopefully it was worth the wait!

[b]Here are some of the most important changes[/b]:

[h2]Better sword fights[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44210720/6f121e6cbfbf16ab568c803e9b6fcf363c4dffac.gif[/img]

There are now 5 different animations that are used depending how you are moving the camera and your character. There are also more visual effects during fights.

[h2]Achievements and Steam Rich Presence[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44210720/2b91188ef7de600e193e8ae40c1db5558eb5a5ee.png[/img]

There are 11 achievements in the demo version, some of them unique for the demo. There will be about 50 in the full version. Additionally Steam will now show your friends what level you currently speeding through.

[h2]Visual improvements[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44210720/f79a17d1fd7f4c450801d5632a67eb86f9862968.gif[/img]

Some levels got more details, there's an outline on water and lava foam, there are new effects during fights, there are key icons instead of text and also some animations and icons were improved.

Also previously the game didn't show all your non-english letters. It still doesn't , but now unicode characters are transliterated so your "英雄" will show as "YingXiong" and your "ἥρως" as "hiros". I will work on this issue further in the upcoming releases.

That's it for today, don't forget to [b]add the game to the wishlist and to follow[/b] for the future updates as the full version will be released this year.

Happy new year everybody!

And here's a full changelog:

- Added more animations to sword fighting
- Achievements
- Steam Rich presence
- Added outline to water and lava foam
- Added more detail to levels
- Added more impact particles
- Keyboard and controller keys' icons
- Better controller handling
- Assist mode can be turned on in pause menu
- Some level changes and bug-fixes
- Memory and CPU optimizations
- Fixes to platform physics
- Fixed ability to make double jump at low frame-rate
- Lots of UI fixes
